### Product defects

None is a 17.7 regression: every defect above reproduces against code unchanged since 17.6.0 (`617f25f8a` / objectui `31971ff1e`) or earlier. No open duplicate was found (nearest closed: #7733, #20107, #19397, #6039).

### Checklist-accuracy findings (no fail attached; for the checklist owner)

1. **access-security:** readonly-package-locks-studio A2's code set omits `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (what a bare `PUT /meta/object/{packaged}` answers; `ITEM_LOCKED` only with `?package=`). audit-log-browser rev 2's "no Action dropdown" is false (AuditLogPage has Action / Object / Actor / date filters). public-form-intake step 6's anonymous path is `/_console/f/contact-us` (`/_console/forms/:name` is the authenticated form). sharing-rule-authoring-ui knownGap: two seeded rules, one on `showcase_contact`. capability-declaration-lifecycle REGRANT must run on a clone (the packaged set is locked, #11513); surface is the `/actions` dispatcher. fls-mask-and-strip step 6: the stock `showcase_client_liaison` already serves the readable:false set; `budget_remaining` is on no form or layout. permission-matrix-edit-loop step 1: use member-owned tasks (RLS decides admin-owned ones); the Studio Access matrix is package-scoped.
2. **identity-auth:** auth-method-matrix: phone-OTP-without-SMS is reachable only under `NODE_ENV=production`; device / OIDC-provider variants have no boot switch; discovery is also served under `/api/v1/auth`. admin-lifecycle A4–A6 assert ruled-not-built routes (#9968 / #9969) and step 2 `list-users` is 403 by the same ruling. session-list-revoke step 4 needs the **raw** `session.token`, and the cross-user list is the "All" tab. api-key surface is Account › Developer › Connect an Agent; `showcase_task` does not discriminate RLS, use `sys_user`. invitation step 7: cancel as admin (delegated_admin holds only `invitation:["create"]`). org-membership step 6: the nav label is static. email-verification A3 / step 4: the mailed link is the API GET (`callbackURL=/` lands on the server root), there is no POST variant. workspace-org-switch A4 holds only on `isolated` (group reads span orgs by design); wall postures need `@objectstack/organizations`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`. self-signup / first-run: the audience gate answers before the toggle; only an invited forge reaches `EMAIL_PASSWORD_SIGN_UP_DISABLED`. oauth-consent: web clients need an https non-loopback redirect. identity-import: the auto-invite mail uses the password-reset template. A role-`admin` invitation needs `accept-invitation` to grant `org_admin`.
3. **studio-authoring:** object-designer step 4: the empty-row banner is the select-needs-options rule (#21390). record-page step 1: type defaults to `list`; no "Layout" section. lifecycle: history versions count draft saves (published revisions are 2 and 4), the diff is shallow, `toVersion:1` is the draft-create, stray keys are refused at draft save, the code is `METADATA_CONFLICT`. validation A2: a flat body gets the "names no viewKind" prescription. expression fixture `quantity * unit_price` infers unknown. metadata-diagnostics A2 lock comes via `servedLockState` (c43a8ae612, #21715); A1 registry 27 vs `/meta/types` 34. custom-page-source-tiers step 8; doc-on-app-menu slug URLs and duplicated sidebar DOM.
4. **records-forms:** object-hook-lifecycle: hooks list at `/meta/hook` (not `/meta/types/hook`), A3 needs `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info`, A8's log text is `[hook] handler failed (onError=log; suppressing)`, A9 needs a runtime-faulting condition and the client sees a generic 500. field-type-constraints: `f_currency` has `currencyConfig:{currencyMode:'fixed',defaultCurrency:'USD'}`; invoice lines need `product`. field-group-visible-when knownGaps stale (both adapters copy `visibleWhen` at the pin). concurrent-edit A2 / A3: the form dialog has no Reload. field-history N1 is ambiguous against the always-on audit History tab. cascading-options persona: invite an org admin.
5. **automation:** scheduled work is off by default (`OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true`). flow-runs-page step 6: filling `new_assignee` suppresses the pause (#15705); the selector lists flow names. formula step 3: `joinNonEmpty([...])` literal fails to type-check, `isBlank("  ")` is false. connector registry: unlisted `showcase_status_openapi`, no `baseUrl` exposed. `showcase_fan_out_notify` needs Slack egress.
6. **integration-system / approvals:** job-scheduled-run: the `enabled:false` skip line is DEBUG. webhook-lifecycle: the shipped org-less row cannot deliver; `lastStatusCode` is `response_code`; redeliver answers enveloped. email-template-render: no HTTP door for sendTemplate (use a notify node), `fromOverride` is an object, raw send answers `{id,status,messageId}`. external-schema: `columnCount` is 7 (not 5); detail route `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/datasource/{name}`. ooo-delegation step 4: `/trigger` cannot open an approval (use a type:'api' hook flow). decision-action-matrix knownGap (org-null requests) stale; inbox filter `?approverId=`; throttle 429 `THROTTLED`. notify-inbox: push dead-letter is a WARN only. preference-suppression: members get 403 on preferences.
7. **platform-core / cli:** metadata-authoring step 2: a plain PUT publishes live; drafts need `?mode=draft&package=` (body `packageId` ignored). package-lifecycle: runtime objects need the namespace prefix. settings-hub: invalid timezone answers `value_domain`; no user-scoped namespace exists. lifecycle-retention: knownGaps[1] stale (TelemetryDatasource is live on stock; seed the telemetry DB), an idle sweep still logs `~0 rows reaped`, the line is INFO. cli scaffold items: the trailing `npm install` fails on a pnpm-installed scaffold (drop it or use pnpm), and both items measure the published scaffolder.
8. **dashboards / search / i18n:** system-overview A2 stale (the Active Sessions widget filters active sessions since #7531) and step 6 has two security tiles. console-global-search A1: ⌘K toggles; step 6 has no "Open full search" entry. i18n strict-translation A4 cites ADR-0049, not #4667; item names must be snake_case (`qa_zh_cn` + `locale:"zh-CN"`). empty-null step 6 should name the `groupBy:["signed_on"]` query.

Environment notes are in the record body. Fixture gaps closed out through the wave's anchor card.
